POV: You Left Your Camera Recording After Midnight 💀 Wednesday Addams, Coraline, Sally or Samara?

short // Oct 14, 2026

Watch on YouTube

You left your phone recording after midnight. 💀

When you check the footage in the morning, you're not alone. Four Halloween icons came through, and you only get to spend Halloween night with one of them.

Your four options

  • Wednesday Addams: deadpan, brilliant and definitely judging you. The Addams Family's darkest daughter, made famous all over again by Jenna Ortega in Netflix's Wednesday.
  • Coraline: the blue-haired kid who found the little door to the Other World in Laika's 2009 stop-motion classic. She's the one who knows not to trust anybody with buttons for eyes.
  • Sally: the stitched-together rag doll from Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas (1993). Sweet, loyal and literally able to sew herself back together.
  • Samara: the girl from the well in The Ring (2002). If she's on your camera roll, you've got seven days.

The safe pick vs. the fun pick

Sally is the safe pick. She'll keep you company and maybe pull a fast one on Oogie Boogie with you.

Wednesday is the fun pick, if you can handle the roasting.

Coraline is the smart pick. She's survived the Other Mother, so she knows a trap when she sees one.

And Samara? That's not a Halloween night. That's a countdown.

Sources: Wikipedia: Wednesday (TV series)), Wikipedia: Coraline (film)), Wikipedia: The Nightmare Before Christmas, Wikipedia: The Ring (2002 film))

Quick answers

Who is Samara from The Ring? The ghost girl from the well in The Ring (2002). Anyone who watches her cursed videotape gets a call saying they have seven days.

What movie is Sally from? Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas (1993), directed by Henry Selick.

What studio made Coraline? Laika, the stop-motion studio, in 2009.

Your turn

Which one are you spending Halloween night with? 1. Wednesday, 2. Coraline, 3. Sally or 4. Samara? Drop your pick in the comments. 🎃👻
